item.title: Republican state senators push changes to Georgia voting machines
item.description: Georgia Senate Republicans pushed last-minute amendments to the state’s election procedures through a committee hearing Monday in an effort to meet their self-imposed deadline to use hand-marked ballots this year. item.title: Augusta University appoints new vice president of audit and compliance
item.description: Maura Conley Copeland, an attorney with more than 20 years of experience in legal affairs, governance and enterprise risk, has been named vice president of Audit, Compliance, Ethics and Risk Management at Augusta University, effective June 1, 2026. The post Augusta University appoints new vice president of audit and compliance appeared first on The Augusta Press.
